description:
This process kicks off when a department identifies the need for a new hire.
HR creates a job description and posts it on job boards.
Resumes are collected and screened, followed by initial phone interviews.
Selected candidates are invited for in-person or virtual interviews depending on each candidate's preference.
Once a candidate is chosen, an offer is extended, and salary negotiations may take place.
After the offer is accepted, the onboarding process begins, including paperwork, orientation, and training.
The process concludes once all onboarding steps are completed and the new hire is fully integrated into the team.

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCandidates" name="Select candidates for interviews"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteCandidates" name="Invite selected candidates" messageRef="Message_InterviewInvitation"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewFormat" name="Choose interview format"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" name="Merge negotiation paths"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductOrientation" name="Conduct orientation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OnboardingJoin" name="All onboarding steps completed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IntegrateNewHire" name="Fully integrate new hire into the team"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_ProcessComplete" name="New hire fully integrated into the team"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Post_Collect" sourceRef="Task_PostJobDescription" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Screen" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Screen_Phone" sourceRef="Task_ScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_ConductPhoneInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Phone_Select" sourceRef="Task_ConductPhoneInterviews" targetRef="Task_SelectCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Invite" sourceRef="Task_SelectCandidates" targetRef="Task_InviteCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invite_Preference" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="Task_ReceivePreference"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preference_Format" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePreference" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Format_InPerson" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">candidate preference is in-person</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Format_Virtual" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">candidate preference is virtual</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InPerson_Merge" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Virtual_Merge" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Choose" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ChooseCandidate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choose_Offer" sourceRef="Task_ChooseCandidate" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offer_Negotiation" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">salary negotiations take place</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipNegotiation" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate_Merge" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiation_Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" targetRef="Event_OfferAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accepted_BeginOnboarding" sourceRef="Event_OfferAccepted" targetRef="Task_BeginOnboarding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeginOnboarding_Split" sourceRef="Task_BeginOnboarding" targetRef="Gateway_OnboardingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Onboarding_Paperwork" sourceRef="Gateway_OnboardingSplit" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Onboarding_Orientation" sourceRef="Gateway_OnboardingSplit" targetRef="Task_ConductOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Onboarding_Training" sourceRef="Gateway_OnboardingSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Paperwork_Join" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Gateway_OnboardingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Orientation_Join" sourceRef="Task_ConductOrientation" targetRef="Gateway_OnboardingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Join" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_OnboardingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Integrate" sourceRef="Gateway_OnboardingJoin" targetRef="Task_IntegrateNewHire"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Integrate_End" sourceRef="Task_IntegrateNewHire" targetRef="Event_ProcessComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Recruitment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Recruitment" name="Recruitment and onboarding process" processRef="Process_Recruitment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Candidate" name="Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invite" name="Interview invitation" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="Participant_Candidate" messageRef="Message_InterviewInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Preference" name="Interview preference" sourceRef="Participant_Candidate" targetRef="Task_ReceivePreference" messageRef="Message_InterviewPreference"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Job offer" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Participant_Candidate" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Offer acceptance" sourceRef="Participant_Candidate" targetRef="Event_OfferAccepted" messageRef="Message_OfferAcceptance"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
